tools.name: gmail_search_messages
tools.description: List or search a limited page of the user's Gmail messages. This is read-only and returns sender, subject, date, message ID, and thread ID. `max_results` limits returned rows and must never be treated as an exact match count. When `hasMore` is true, do not count returned messages by sender or use them as bulk-action totals. For exact cleanup counts, load the Gmail skill and use a reviewed sender-digest cache or a query dry run. For unread inbox mail, use query `in:inbox is:unread`.

max_results.description: Maximum number of messages to return. Defaults to 5.

query.description: Optional Gmail search query, such as `in:inbox is:unread`.

fields.description: Optional compatibility hint. Results always include sender, subject, date, message ID, and thread ID.

tools.name: gmail_create_draft
tools.description: Create a Gmail draft for review without sending it. If `to` is omitted or is `self`, `me`, or `myself`, the recipient defaults to the connected Gmail account.

to.description: Recipient email address. Omit or use `self` to draft to the connected Gmail account.
